name: Chu~ka na Janshi Tenhou Pai Nyan
original_name: ちゅ～かな雀士 てんほー牌娘
source: In 1893, under the order of Empress Cixi, Ling Lingling leaves mainland China and heads for Japan for a secret mission. Ling must collect all the “Sessho-seki", which seals the spiritual power of the nine-tailed fox. By transforming into a "Chuuka Mahjong Tenhou Girl", Ling will have to challenge the owners of the "Sessho-seki" with Mahjong one by one, and win back their trophy to save the world.
translation: 1893年，受慈禧太后之命，鈴鈴鈴離開中國大陸，前往日本執行秘密任務。她必須收集封印著九尾狐靈力的全部「殺生石」。變身為「中華雀士天和牌娘」後，鈴鈴鈴將逐一向殺生石的持有者發起麻將挑戰，贏回他們手中的寶物，拯救世界。
